subject: Bridge letter request — audit interval clarification for SOC 2 Type II
messages:
From: Maya Leon <maya.leon@solistech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solistech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — Bridge letter to cover audit interval for SOC 2 Type II

Aditya,

Thanks for taking this — our procurement team has a hard requirement to see continuous coverage from the vendor. We reviewed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2025-12-31) and need a vendor attestation that covers the gap between that report end date and the current evaluation date (we're targeting 2026-06-30). In short: a bridge letter or post-report attestation describing that there have been no material control failures or scope changes since 2025-12-31 through 2026-06-30.

Can you confirm if Redwood provides a signed bridge letter? If so, procurement prefers the letter to be signed by either the Head of Security or Legal. We also need a short summary of any control changes and confirmation of whether any subservice organizations were added or removed in the interval.

Deliverables our side needs:
- Signed bridge letter (PDF) covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30
- Copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (we have your 2024 report but want the 2025 T2)
- Short explanation of any interim changes to change management, access control, or incident response (1 paragraph each)

If you need to coordinate with your auditor for any additional language, please loop them in. We can be flexible on signature authority if you explain who will sign. Would you be able to provide a draft by end of week? We have an internal review on Thursday.

Thanks,
Maya
Solis Tech — Procurement
Attachments: none

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Maya Leon <maya.leon@solistech.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — Bridge letter to cover audit interval for SOC 2 Type II

On Mon, Jun 29, 2026 at 09:12 AM Maya Leon <maya.leon@solistech.com> wrote:
> Aditya,
>
> Thanks for taking this — our procurement team has a hard requirement to see continuous coverage from the vendor...

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a bridge letter covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30. A few quick clarifying points so we deliver exactly what procurement needs: 

1) Signature: Our standard practice is for the Director of Security to sign bridge attestations; Legal can countersign on request. Is a signature from Redwood's Head of Security acceptable, or do you need an in-house legal sign-off?
2) Scope: You asked for the SOC 2 Type II report — do you mean the most recent 12-month report that ended 2025-12-31 (we'll attach that), or do you need any additional workpapers?
3) Auditor language: If procurement requires a statement from our independent auditor (NorthPoint), that is a separate ask — we can reach out to them but it takes extra time.

I'll attach our SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2025-12-31) and a Redwood bridge-letter template for your review. Lauren (Security Ops) and Grace (Compliance) are cc'd to confirm the control-change paragraphs.

Proposed timeline: draft to you by EOD Wednesday, final signed PDF by next Monday, unless you need faster.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_T2_2025_report.pdf, redwood_bridge_template.docx

From: Maya Leon <maya.leon@solistech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solistech.com>, NorthPoint Audit <secops@northpointaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — Bridge letter to cover audit interval for SOC 2 Type II

Thanks Aditya — that timeline should work. A few clarifications from procurement after I forwarded your note: 

- Signature: they prefer either Head of Security or VP Legal. If you provide Head of Security, please include name and title in the letter body.
- Auditor: we do not require NorthPoint to provide language in the bridge letter, but procurement may ask for a short statement confirming NorthPoint has no outstanding material exceptions for the period; if they ask we will let you know.
- Scope: the SOC 2 report you attached (period ended 2025-12-31) is the one they expect. No additional workpapers required unless procurement escalates.

Also: procurement asked for a one-paragraph explanation of any "control-impacting changes" since 2025-12-31. If there were no material changes, a short negative statement is fine. 

Would you be available for a 20 minute call today at 11:00am PT to run through the draft? If not, we can do Wednesday morning.

Best,
Maya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Maya Leon <maya.leon@solistech.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, NorthPoint Audit <secops@northpointaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Bridge letter draft and signature path

Maya — attaching a draft bridge letter and proposed signature plan. We're prepared to have our Director of Security sign; Legal will countersign on the final PDF if Solis needs that. 

Draft highlights (attached):
- Covers period 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30
- Affirms there have been no material exceptions identified by internal controls testing since the SOC 2 report period end
- Includes one-paragraph summaries for change management, access control, and incident response (no material changes)
- Notes the SOC 2 report scope and confirms no subservice organizations were added in the interval

Attachments:
- bridge_letter_draft_solistech_signed.docx (draft for review)
- Redwood_SOC2_T2_2025_report.pdf (for your records)

Signature path: we can execute via DocuSign (link below) or provide a signed PDF from our Director of Security. Please confirm which you prefer and the name/title required on the letter (procurement said VP Legal or Head of Security).

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/link/abc123-redwood-bridge
Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-cfBridgeTemplate

If procurement confirms they only need the Director of Security signature, we'll finalize the signed PDF by EOD Monday. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want text edits.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
Attachments: bridge_letter_draft_solistech_signed.docx, Redwood_SOC2_T2_2025_report.pdf
